Our visitor on tee pad #6 during SpAm just wanted some attention.   
Figured I would help out!!

Random draw doubles disc golf at my house 10/10/26: $ 7 gets lights for your normal putters and entry into 7 different payouts. 36 holes of PAR-2, and 9 holes of PAR-3 mini. Bring a friend, a beverage or two, and enjoy some fun social golf. Be registered and ready for play by 7:30PM. SAY IN BELOW FOR ALL WHO WILL ATTEND.....We'll see you by the fire...608 Woodford Street 22401

The 2nd Annual G.U.F.F. charity tournament is in 11 days!! WOOHOO!  and the fun keeps coming! @[61579408484436:2048:Pour Decisions Co LLC] has created a GUFF drink you can purchase at the tournament !  it's got rootbeer! ( my personal favorite!) See picture below! 

Par Saver has signed on and is sending us some of their gear! check out their website! 

https://parsavedg.com/

Your participation in this event will go a long way to help Grace and Peace Community Ministries ( graceandpeacerva.com) and the families they work with ! Thank you so much for your support last year and this year! 

  Get registered !
Yo, John Biscoe said bag tags, NOT minis.  Whose the wise guy that did this?

FREE Putting League today at 6 pm at 6 Bears & A Goat Brewery. 🥏⛓️🍻
Please be there to sign up by 5:45 pm.

Let us know if you will be joining us.

2026 Spotsy Club Championship Saturday December 12th at Loriella Park!!!

1 round of stroke play followed by match play in each division to determine the winners. Must have been a club member on October 1st 2026 to be eligible. Pro/FPO/MA1/FA1/MA2/MA3/MA4

We will be having a potluck lunch between rounds. The club will start the food off with some dominos pizzas and Biscoe BBQ so please sign up for some side dishes.

Details are being finalized and registration will open tomorrow so be on the lookout for a DGS link to the event.

17 days!!!! The 2nd annual G.U.F.F. charity doubles tournament is just 17 days away!!  

As an added bonus @[61552709372982:2048:Treemagnets] is giving every player a $5 coupon just for registering! 

  Again we couldn't do this without all of you and our friends at @[100042034766923:2048:Fly High Sports] , @[61579408484436:2048:Pour Decisions Co LLC] , @[100064902605827:2048:Prodigy Disc] , @[61572304015150:2048:Glow Labs] , @[100066902446390:2048:River City Disc Golf] , and Truetimbers!!!  

 If you haven't registered your team, what are you waiting for?! 

  Don't forget the Distance championship at the end!! 

https://www.discgolfscene.com/tournament/2nd_Annual_GUFF_Fun_Raier_2026

Did you miss out on the chance to get tickets to USDGC/TPWDGC?

You still have 4 more weeks absolutely FREE entry!

**Today is the last day! September 29!**

Ace Pot is at $100

(Sign up by 5:45 pm and start at 6 pm)

Winner of the 4 weeks, most overall points, will win 2 VIP Passes (Friends & Family) to Championship Week at Winthrop University!

Winner each week (minimum of 4 players) will receive a day pass ($35 value) to Championship Week ’26 at Winthrop University.

Double elimination bracket.
